title: Reliability and Generalization in UAV Crop-Weed Mapping: A Scoping Review
unit_of_analysis: Linked study/report families, with separate evaluation-setting rows for each materially distinct dataset/split/shift/target-data-use condition; repeated seeds are grouped within a setting.
trustworthiness_framework: Transparent scoping evidence map with PRISMA-ScR reporting; protocol-specific provenance and evaluation-design charting.
epistemological_rationale: Descriptive evidence mapping combines structured counts with qualitative comparison of evaluation designs; it does not estimate pooled causal effects or assume generalization from reported accuracy.

inclusion_criteria.criterion: Uses UAV-acquired imagery for crop/weed detection, segmentation, or spatial weed mapping in an agricultural field context; UAV results must be separable in mixed-platform studies.

Primary empirical method study or dataset/benchmark report describing a UAV crop/weed mapping method, experiment, or annotated dataset. Journal, conference, and substantive preprint reports are eligible. Missing evaluation details are charted as not reported; inaccessible full text remains pending retrieval rather than excluded.

Published from 2020 through the recorded final search cutoff, inclusive; English full text in the provisional scope. Older foundational sources remain background unless a logged amendment expands eligibility.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Satellite-only, ground-robot-only, handheld, or laboratory imaging with no separable eligible UAV mapping evidence.
UAV navigation/SLAM, yield, disease, phenotyping, or non-agricultural mapping without a separable crop/weed localization or mapping task.

Confirmed review, editorial, commentary, protocol-only report, or abstract-only publication with no associated substantive primary report. An incomplete search-provider abstract or failure to retrieve full text is not this exclusion; retain useful reviews as background.
Outside the frozen publication date or language scope after bibliographic/full-text verification.
